title: Release manifest
description: Every file of one release of one service, with its SHA-256 and size, and the URL path where it is served verbatim (null for files that are not served as-is, such as a Worker's script or the host's routing files). The manifest is the artifact that is signed: its SHA-256 is the release digest, the subject of the SLSA provenance and the build.digest of /healthz. Served at /.well-known/diagnos/manifest.json; it never lists /healthz, /healthz.json or anything under /.well-known/diagnos/.

path.description: Path relative to the release's root directory, with / separators, no leading slash, no . or .. segments. Never healthz, healthz.json or anything under .well-known/diagnos/ (producers and verifiers enforce this; the pattern cannot).

served.description: URL path where this exact file is returned with status 200 (after same-host redirects), or null.
